titre: Les GLP-1 se prennent surtout avec l'insuline
sous_titre: Part des adultes diabétiques diagnostiqués utilisant un GLP-1 injectable, en %, États-Unis, 2024

Ensemble.texte: In 2024, more than one in four adults with diagnosed diabetes used GLP-1 injectables (26.5%)

Sous insuline.texte: Nearly one in three adults with diagnosed diabetes who reported taking insulin (31.3%) also used GLP-1 injectables

Sous traitement oral.texte: More than one in four adults with diagnosed diabetes who took oral glucose-lowering medications (28.1%) also used GLP-1 injectables

Sans insuline.texte: compared with those who did not take those diabetic medications (24.5% and 22.2%, respectively)
